neighbours.label: ' to' after 'inability' or 'capacity' when describing a mental-health symptom
fire: Major depression often brings an inability to feel pleasure.
People with schizophrenia can show a diminished capacity to plan.
Chronic anxiety may cause inability to relax at night.
Many veterans with PTSD describe an inability to trust others.
Late-stage dementia brings a reduced ability to speak.
Severe burnout and low mood can lead to an inability to cope.
Those with ADHD often report a poor ability to concentrate.
Psychosis may produce an inability to think clearly.
quiet: A torn ligament often brings an inability to bend the knee.
People with arthritis can show a limited capacity to climb stairs.
The old truck showed an inability to climb steep hills.
Many veterans with PTSD describe trouble with sleep and nightmares.
Late-stage dementia brings memory loss and confusion.
The small firm had an inability to pay its suppliers.
Those with ADHD often report restlessness and poor focus.
A sprained ankle may produce an inability to walk far.

notes: Psychological words such as ' cognitive' and ' psychological' also appear in the top examples, and this test does not cover them. Near misses keep the phrase in physical or non-medical cases, or keep the condition without the phrase.
